author: smuzaffar
body:
In UBSAN IBs, we get runtime error [a]. This happens when we try to access the first element of empty `const edm::Handle<TrackingVertexCollection> &simVerticesH`https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/Validation/RecoVertex/src/SecondaryVertexAnalyzerAlgo.cc#L302 . This PR proposses to return immediately for empty collection. This change does not change the logic it just return early with empty `result`. 

@JanGerritSchulz , I guess you added this code via https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51577 . Can you please look in to it . May be there is bug some where else and `simVerticesH` was not suppose to be empty ?


[a] https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/buildlogs/raw/el9_amd64_gcc14/CMSSW_20_1_UBSAN_X_2026-09-28-2300/pyRelValMatrixLogs/run/38461.0_NuGun+Run4D128/step3.log
